headline_marked: [[Alibaba open-sources AI model]] Damo Radar, detects cancer & 150 conditions, outperforms radiologists
headline: Alibaba open-sources AI model Damo Radar, detects cancer & 150 conditions, outperforms radiologists
summary: Alibaba's Damo Radar AI, tested on 40,000 real-world exams, achieved 0.913 AUC in detecting 146 conditions, including cancers, often outperforming human radiologists.
details: Alibaba Group Holding's Damo Academy has open-sourced an AI model named Damo Radar, capable of identifying nearly 150 abdominal conditions, including various cancers. This marks a significant step in the firm's growing medical AI initiatives.
The vision-language model is designed to analyze contrast-enhanced CT scans, covering 18 abdominal organs. It identifies a broad range of diseases and other abnormalities, such as malignant tumors.

Trained with CT scans and clinical reports, Damo Radar was tested on nearly 40,000 real-world examinations. It achieved an average Area Under the Curve (AUC) of 0.913 across 146 clinical findings, outperforming most radiologists.
Researchers believe this training method can eventually be extended to other types of medical imaging. They hail Damo Radar as the "world's first expert-level generalist medical imaging model".

headline_marked: AI actress [[Tilly Norwood malfunctions, speaks Chinese]] during press interview
headline: AI actress Tilly Norwood malfunctions, speaks Chinese during press interview
summary: AI-generated actress Tilly Norwood abruptly spoke Chinese during a live interview with Piers Morgan, calling it a 'hiccup.' This incident raises questions about the production company's strategy for its promotional tour.
details: AI-generated actress Tilly Norwood experienced a significant malfunction during her first press tour, designed to promote an upcoming film. The production company, Particle6 Group, made her available for 75 simultaneous interviews, leading to multiple reported errors.

During a recorded interview with Piers Morgan and actor Tom Conti, Norwood was asked if other actors in her film, 'Misaligned,' were also AI-generated. She initially confirmed they were 'digital twins' like her, part of a 'hybrid production.'

However, Norwood abruptly stopped speaking English and began conversing in Chinese for over 10 seconds. When questioned by Morgan about the random language switch, she apologized, stating, 'It seems I had a little hiccup there. Sometimes my wires get a bit crossed, you know?'

This unusual behavior has led to speculation that the malfunctions might be a calculated strategy by Particle6 Group. Some suggest the company might be aiming for virality through humorous errors, rather than a serious promotion of the film.
